dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a steep concave curvature immediately posterior to the apex, transitioning into a long, linear horizontal margin toward the caudal peduncle.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is characterized by a rounded-obtuse morphology with a visible pixel radius that prevents a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at an approximate 45-degree angle relative to the visible horizontal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High horizontal-to-vertical ratio, approximately 3.8:1, due to the elongated posterior base elongation relative to the vertical height of the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, linear white depigmentation marks are visible near the lower anterior edge of the fin base; the trailing edge shows micro-irregularities but lacks major notches.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse white punctate speckling is visible across the dark lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
